t: You're at St Mary's Church in Rotherhithe, an eighteenth-century Church of England parish church on St Marychurch Street. It's still a living, working church, and it's particularly proud of its links to the Pilgrim Fathers. Buried here is Prince Lee Boo, who died in 1784. He was the son of the ruler of Koror in Palau, and one of the first Pacific Islanders to visit Britain. Captain Henry Wilson, whose ship Antelope was wrecked on Palau, spent three months there with his crew, then took Lee Boo to London to learn about Europe.
